versos.hebraico: וַֽיִּגְּשׁ֗וּ רָאשֵׁי֙ אֲב֣וֹת הַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֶל־אֶלְעָזָר֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן־נ֑וּן וְאֶל־רָאשֵׁ֛י אֲב֥וֹת הַמַּטּ֖וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: Then the heads of fathers’ houses of the Levites came near to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel.
controles.kjv: Then came near the heads of the fathers of the Levites unto Eleazar the priest, and unto Joshua the son of Nun, and unto the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel;
controles.livre: E os principais dos pais dos levitas vieram a Eleazar sacerdote, e a Josué filho de Num, e aos principais dos pais das tribos dos filhos de Israel;

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבְּר֨וּ אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם בְּשִׁלֹ֗ה בְּאֶ֤רֶץ כְּנַ֨עַן֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יְהוָה֙ צִוָּ֣ה בְיַד־מֹשֶׁ֔ה לָֽתֶת־לָ֥נוּ עָרִ֖ים לָשָׁ֑בֶת וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶ֖ן לִבְהֶמְתֵּֽנוּ׃

controles.web: They spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, “Yahweh commanded Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with their suburbs for our livestock.”
controles.kjv: And they spake unto them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, The Lord commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with the suburbs thereof for our cattle.
controles.livre: E falaram-lhes em Siló na terra de Canaã, dizendo: O SENHOR mandou por Moisés que nos fossem dadas vilas para habitar, com seus campos para nossos animais.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל לַלְוִיִּ֛ם מִנַּחֲלָתָ֖ם אֶל־פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֶת־הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְאֶת־מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽן׃

controles.web: The children of Israel gave to the Levites out of their inheritance, according to the commandment of Yahweh, these cities with their suburbs.
controles.kjv: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance, at the commandment of the Lord, these cities and their suburbs.
controles.livre: Então os filhos de Israel deram aos levitas de suas possessões, conforme a palavra do SENHOR, estas vilas com seus campos.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּצֵ֥א הַגּוֹרָ֖ל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַקְּהָתִ֑י וַיְהִ֡י לִבְנֵי֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַכֹּהֵ֜ן מִן־הַלְוִיִּ֗ם מִמַּטֵּ֣ה יְ֠הוּדָה וּמִמַּטֵּ֨ה הַשִּׁמְעֹנִ֜י וּמִמַּטֵּ֤ה בִנְיָמִן֙ בַּגּוֹרָ֔ל עָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃ס

controles.web: The lot came out for the families of the Kohathites. The children of Aaron the priest, who were of the Levites, had thirteen cities by lot out of the tribe of Judah, out of the tribe of the Simeonites, and out of the tribe of Benjamin.
controles.kjv: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites: and the children of Aaron the priest, which were of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Judah, and out of the tribe of Simeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.
controles.livre: E saiu a sorte para as famílias dos coatitas; e foram dadas por porção aos filhos de Arão sacerdote, que eram dos levitas, pela tribo de Judá, pela de Simeão e pela de Benjamim, treze vilas.

versos.hebraico: וְלִבְנֵ֨י קְהָ֜ת הַנּוֹתָרִ֗ים מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת מַטֵּֽה־אֶ֠פְרַיִם וּֽמִמַּטֵּה־דָ֞ן וּמֵחֲצִ֨י מַטֵּ֧ה מְנַשֶּׁ֛ה בַּגּוֹרָ֖ל עָרִ֥ים עָֽשֶׂר׃ס

controles.web: The rest of the children of Kohath had ten cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh.
controles.kjv: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.
controles.livre: E aos outros filhos de Coate se deram por porção dez vilas das famílias da tribo de Efraim, e da tribo de Dã, e da meia tribo de Manassés;

versos.hebraico: וְלִבְנֵ֣י גֵרְשׁ֗וֹן מִמִּשְׁפְּח֣וֹת מַטֵּֽה־יִשָּׂשכָ֣ר וּמִמַּטֵּֽה־אָ֠שֵׁר וּמִמַּטֵּ֨ה נַפְתָּלִ֜י וּ֠מֵחֲצִי מַטֵּ֨ה מְנַשֶּׁ֤ה בַבָּשָׁן֙ בַּגּוֹרָ֔ל עָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃ס

controles.web: The children of Gershon had thirteen cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, out of the tribe of Asher, out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
controles.kjv: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
controles.livre: E aos filhos de Gérson, pelas famílias da tribo de Issacar, e da tribo de Aser, e da tribo de Naftali, e da meia tribo de Manassés em Basã, foram dadas por porção treze vilas.

versos.hebraico: לִבְנֵ֨י מְרָרִ֜י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֗ם מִמַּטֵּ֨ה רְאוּבֵ֤ן וּמִמַּטֵּה־גָד֙ וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה זְבוּלֻ֔ן עָרִ֖ים שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃

controles.web: The children of Merari according to their families had twelve cities out of the tribe of Reuben, out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun.
controles.kjv: The children of Merari by their families had out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
controles.livre: Aos filhos de Merari por suas famílias se deram doze vilas pela tribo de Rúben, e pela tribo de Gade, e pela tribo de Zebulom.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֶת־הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְאֶת־מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶ֑ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁ֖ה בַּגּוֹרָֽל׃פ

controles.web: The children of Israel gave these cities with their suburbs by lot to the Levites, as Yahweh commanded by Moses.
controles.kjv: And the children of Israel gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with their suburbs, as the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses.
controles.livre: E assim deram por sorte os filhos de Israel aos levitas estas vilas com seus campos, como o SENHOR o havia mandado por Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ מִמַּטֵּה֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּמִמַּטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֑וֹן אֵ֚ת הֶֽעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרָ֥א אֶתְהֶ֖ן בְּשֵֽׁם׃

controles.web: They gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are mentioned by name:
controles.kjv: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are here mentioned by name,
controles.livre: E da tribo dos filhos de Judá, e da tribo dos filhos de Simeão deram estas vilas que foram nomeadas:

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְהִי֙ לִבְנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן מִמִּשְׁפְּח֥וֹת הַקְּהָתִ֖י מִבְּנֵ֣י לֵוִ֑י כִּ֥י לָהֶ֛ם הָיָ֥ה הַגּוֹרָ֖ל רִיאשֹׁנָֽה׃

controles.web: and they were for the children of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi; for theirs was the first lot.
controles.kjv: Which the children of Aaron, being of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi, had: for theirs was the first lot.
controles.livre: E a primeira porção foi dos filhos de Arão, da família de Coate, dos filhos de Levi;

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ לָהֶ֜ם אֶת־קִרְיַת֩ אַרְבַּ֨ע אֲבִ֧י הָֽעֲנ֛וֹק הִ֥יא חֶבְר֖וֹן בְּהַ֣ר יְהוּדָ֑ה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֖הָ סְבִיבֹתֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: They gave them Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (the same is Hebron), in the hill country of Judah, with its suburbs around it.
controles.kjv: And they gave them the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron, in the hill country of Judah, with the suburbs thereof round about it.
controles.livre: Aos quais deram Quiriate-Arba, do pai de Anaque, a qual é Hebrom, no monte de Judá, com seus campos em seus entornos.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־שְׂדֵ֥ה הָעִ֖יר וְאֶת־חֲצֵרֶ֑יהָ נָֽתְנ֛וּ לְכָלֵ֥ב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּ֖ה בַּאֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ׃ס

controles.web: But they gave the fields of the city and its villages to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.
controles.kjv: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.
controles.livre: Mas o campo desta cidade e suas aldeias deram a Calebe filho de Jefoné, por sua possessão.

versos.hebraico: וְלִבְנֵ֣י׀ אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֗ן נָֽתְנוּ֙ אֶת־עִיר֙ מִקְלַ֣ט הָרֹצֵ֔חַ אֶת־חֶבְר֖וֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ וְאֶת־לִבְנָ֖ה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃

controles.web: To the children of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron with its suburbs, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Libnah with its suburbs,
controles.kjv: Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Libnah with her suburbs,
controles.livre: E aos filhos de Arão, o sacerdote, deram a cidade de refúgio para os homicidas, a Hebrom com seus campos; e a Libna com seus campos,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־יַתִּר֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־אֶשְׁתְּמֹ֖עַ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃

controles.web: Jattir with its suburbs, Eshtemoa with its suburbs,
controles.kjv: And Jattir with her suburbs, and Eshtemoa with her suburbs,
controles.livre: E a Jatir com seus campos, e a Estemoa com seus campos,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־חֹלֹן֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־דְּבִ֖ר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃

controles.web: Holon with its suburbs, Debir with its suburbs,
controles.kjv: And Holon with her suburbs, and Debir with her suburbs,
controles.livre: A Holom com seus campos, e a Debir com seus campos,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־עַ֣יִן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֗הָ וְאֶת־יֻטָּה֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ אֶת־בֵּ֥ית שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֣ים תֵּ֔שַׁע מֵאֵ֕ת שְׁנֵ֥י הַשְּׁבָטִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃פ

controles.web: Ain with its suburbs, Juttah with its suburbs, and Beth Shemesh with its suburbs; nine cities out of those two tribes.
controles.kjv: And Ain with her suburbs, and Juttah with her suburbs, and Beth–shemesh with her suburbs; nine cities out of those two tribes.
controles.livre: A Aim com seus campos, a Jutá com seus campos, e a Bete-Semes com seus campos; nove vilas destas duas tribos:

versos.hebraico: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה בִנְיָמִ֔ן אֶת־גִּבְע֖וֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ אֶת־גֶּ֖בַע וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃

controles.web: Out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with its suburbs, Geba with its suburbs,
controles.kjv: And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with her suburbs, Geba with her suburbs,
controles.livre: E da tribo de Benjamim, a Gibeom com seus campos, a Geba com seus campos,

versos.hebraico: אֶת־עֲנָתוֹת֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־עַלְמ֖וֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃

controles.web: Anathoth with its suburbs, and Almon with its suburbs; four cities.
controles.kjv: Anathoth with her suburbs, and Almon with her suburbs; four cities.
controles.livre: A Anatote com seus campos, a Almom com seus campos: quatro vilas.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־עָרֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּֽהֲנִ֑ים שְׁלֹשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה עָרִ֖ים וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽן׃ס

controles.web: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their suburbs.
controles.kjv: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their suburbs.
controles.livre: Todas as vilas dos sacerdotes, filhos de Arão, são treze com seus campos.

versos.hebraico: וּלְמִשְׁפְּח֤וֹת בְּנֵֽי־קְהָת֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם הַנּוֹתָרִ֖ים מִבְּנֵ֣י קְהָ֑ת וַֽיְהִי֙ עָרֵ֣י גֽוֹרָלָ֔ם מִמַּטֵּ֖ה אֶפְרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: The families of the children of Kohath, the Levites, even the rest of the children of Kohath, had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.
controles.kjv: And the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites which remained of the children of Kohath, even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.
controles.livre: Mas as famílias dos filhos de Coate, levitas, os que restavam dos filhos de Coate, receberam por porção vilas da tribo de Efraim.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ לָהֶ֜ם אֶת־עִ֨יר מִקְלַ֧ט הָרֹצֵ֛חַ אֶת־שְׁכֶ֥ם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֖הָ בְּהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וְאֶת־גֶּ֖זֶר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃

controles.web: They gave them Shechem with its suburbs in the hill country of Ephraim, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Gezer with its suburbs,
controles.kjv: For they gave them Shechem with her suburbs in mount Ephraim, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Gezer with her suburbs,
controles.livre: E deram-lhes a Siquém, vila de refúgio para os homicidas, com seus campos, no monte de Efraim; e a Gezer com seus campos.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־קִבְצַ֨יִם֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־בֵּ֥ית חוֹרֹ֖ן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃ס

controles.web: Kibzaim with its suburbs, and Beth Horon with its suburbs; four cities.
controles.kjv: And Kibzaim with her suburbs, and Beth–horon with her suburbs; four cities.
controles.livre: E a Quibzaim com seus campos, e a Bete-Horom com seus campos: quatro vilas:

versos.hebraico: וּמִמַּ֨טֵּה־דָ֔ן אֶֽת־אֶלְתְּקֵ֖א וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ אֶֽת־גִּבְּת֖וֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃

controles.web: Out of the tribe of Dan, Elteke with its suburbs, Gibbethon with its suburbs,
controles.kjv: And out of the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh with her suburbs, Gibbethon with her suburbs,
controles.livre: E da tribo de Dã a Elteque com seus campos, a Gibetom com seus campos,

versos.hebraico: אֶת־אַיָּלוֹן֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ אֶת־גַּת־רִמּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃ס

controles.web: Aijalon with its suburbs, Gath Rimmon with its suburbs; four cities.
controles.kjv: Aijalon with her suburbs, Gath–rimmon with her suburbs; four cities.
controles.livre: A Aijalom com seus campos, a Gate-Rimom com seus campos: quatro vilas:

versos.hebraico: וּמִֽמַּחֲצִית֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה אֶת־תַּעְנַךְ֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־גַּת־רִמּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים שְׁתָּֽיִם׃

controles.web: Out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Taanach with its suburbs, and Gath Rimmon with its suburbs; two cities.
controles.kjv: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh, Tanach with her suburbs, and Gath–rimmon with her suburbs; two cities.
controles.livre: E da meia tribo de Manassés, a Taanaque com seus campos, e a Gate-Rimom com seus campos: duas vilas.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־עָרִ֥ים עֶ֖שֶׂר וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶ֑ן לְמִשְׁפְּח֥וֹת בְּנֵֽי־קְהָ֖ת הַנּוֹתָרִֽים׃ס

controles.web: All the cities of the families of the rest of the children of Kohath were ten with their suburbs.
controles.kjv: All the cities were ten with their suburbs for the families of the children of Kohath that remained.
controles.livre: Todas as vilas para o resto das famílias dos filhos de Coate foram dez com seus campos.

versos.hebraico: וְלִבְנֵ֣י גֵרְשׁוֹן֮ מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַלְוִיִּם֒ מֵחֲצִ֞י מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה אֶת־עִיר֙ מִקְלַ֣ט הָרֹצֵ֔חַ אֶת־גלון בַּבָּשָׁן֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶֽת־בְּעֶשְׁתְּרָ֖ה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים שְׁתָּֽיִם׃ס

controles.web: They gave to the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the half-tribe of Manasseh Golan in Bashan with its suburbs, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Be Eshterah with its suburbs; two cities.
controles.kjv: And unto the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the other half tribe of Manasseh they gave Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Beesh–terah with her suburbs; two cities.
controles.livre: Aos filhos de Gérson das famílias dos levitas, deram a vila de refúgio para os homicidas, da meia tribo de Manassés: a Golã em Basã com seus campos, e a Beesterá com seus campos: duas vilas.

versos.hebraico: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה יִשָּׂשכָ֔ר אֶת־קִשְׁי֖וֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ אֶת־דָּֽבְרַ֖ת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃

controles.web: Out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishion with its suburbs, Daberath with its suburbs,
controles.kjv: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishon with her suburbs, Dabareh with her suburbs,
controles.livre: E da tribo de Issacar, a Quisiom com seus campos, a Daberate com seus campos,

versos.hebraico: אֶת־יַרְמוּת֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ אֶת־עֵ֥ין גַּנִּ֖ים וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃ס

controles.web: Jarmuth with its suburbs, En Gannim with its suburbs; four cities.
controles.kjv: Jarmuth with her suburbs, En–gannim with her suburbs; four cities.
controles.livre: A Jarmute com seus campos, e a En-Ganim com seus campos: quatro vilas:

versos.hebraico: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה אָשֵׁ֔ר אֶת־מִשְׁאָ֖ל וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ אֶת־עַבְדּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃

controles.web: Out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with its suburbs, Abdon with its suburbs,
controles.kjv: And out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with her suburbs, Abdon with her suburbs,
controles.livre: E da tribo de Aser, a Misal com seus campos, a Abdom com seus campos,

versos.hebraico: אֶת־חֶלְקָת֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־רְחֹ֖ב וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃ס

controles.web: Helkath with its suburbs, and Rehob with its suburbs; four cities.
controles.kjv: Helkath with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs; four cities.
controles.livre: A Helcate com seus campos, e a Reobe com seus campos: quatro vilas:

versos.hebraico: וּמִמַּטֵּ֨ה נַפְתָּלִ֜י אֶת־עִ֣יר׀ מִקְלַ֣ט הָֽרֹצֵ֗חַ אֶת־קֶ֨דֶשׁ בַּגָּלִ֤יל וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֨הָ֙ וְאֶת־חַמֹּ֥ת דֹּאר֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־קַרְתָּ֖ן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים שָׁלֹֽשׁ׃

controles.web: Out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its suburbs, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Hammothdor with its suburbs, and Kartan with its suburbs; three cities.
controles.kjv: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Hammoth–dor with her suburbs, and Kartan with her suburbs; three cities.
controles.livre: E da tribo de Naftali, a vila de refúgio para os homicidas, a Quedes na Galileia com seus campos, a Hamote-Dor com seus campos, e a Cartã com seus campos: três vilas:

versos.hebraico: כָּל־עָרֵ֥י הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֖י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם שְׁלֹשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה עִ֖יר וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽן׃ס

controles.web: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs.
controles.kjv: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs.
controles.livre: Todas as vilas dos gersonitas por suas famílias foram treze vilas com seus campos.

versos.hebraico: וּלְמִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת בְּנֵֽי־מְרָרִי֮ הַלְוִיִּ֣ם הַנּוֹתָרִים֒ מֵאֵת֙ מַטֵּ֣ה זְבוּלֻ֔ן אֶֽת־יָקְנְעָ֖ם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ אֶת־קַרְתָּ֖ה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃

controles.web: To the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with its suburbs, Kartah with its suburbs,
controles.kjv: And unto the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with her suburbs, and Kartah with her suburbs,
controles.livre: E às famílias dos filhos de Merari, levitas que restavam, deu-se a eles da tribo de Zebulom, a Jocneão com seus campos, Cartá com seus campos,

versos.hebraico: אֶת־דִּמְנָה֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ אֶֽת־נַהֲלָ֖ל וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃

controles.web: Dimnah with its suburbs, and Nahalal with its suburbs; four cities.
controles.kjv: Dimnah with her suburbs, Nahalal with her suburbs; four cities.
controles.livre: Dimna com seus campos, Naalal com seus campos: quatro vilas:

versos.hebraico: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֔ן אֶת־בֶּ֖צֶר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ וְאֶת־יַ֖הְצָה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃

controles.web: Out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with its suburbs, Jahaz with its suburbs,
controles.kjv: And out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with her suburbs, and Jahazah with her suburbs,
controles.livre: E da tribo de Rúben, a Bezer com seus campos, a Jaza com seus campos,

versos.hebraico: אֶת־קְדֵמוֹת֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־מֵיפָ֖עַת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃ס

controles.web: Kedemoth with its suburbs, and Mephaath with its suburbs; four cities.
controles.kjv: Kedemoth with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs; four cities.
controles.livre: A Quedemote com seus campos, e Mefaate com seus campos: quatro vilas:

versos.hebraico: וּמִמַּטֵּה־גָ֗ד אֶת־עִיר֙ מִקְלַ֣ט הָרֹצֵ֔חַ אֶת־רָמֹ֥ת בַּגִּלְעָ֖ד וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ וְאֶֽת־מַחֲנַ֖יִם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃

controles.web: Out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its suburbs, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Mahanaim with its suburbs,
controles.kjv: And out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Mahanaim with her suburbs,
controles.livre: Da tribo de Gade, a vila de refúgio para os homicidas, Ramote em Gileade com seus campos, e Maanaim com seus campos,

versos.hebraico: אֶת־חֶשְׁבּוֹן֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ אֶת־יַעְזֵ֖ר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ כָּל־עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃

controles.web: Heshbon with its suburbs, Jazer with its suburbs; four cities in all.
controles.kjv: Heshbon with her suburbs, Jazer with her suburbs; four cities in all.
controles.livre: Hesbom com seus campos, e Jazer com seus campos: quatro vilas.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־הֶ֨עָרִ֜ים לִבְנֵ֤י מְרָרִי֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔ם הַנּוֹתָרִ֖ים מִמִּשְׁפְּח֣וֹת הַלְוִיִּ֑ם וַיְהִי֙ גּוֹרָלָ֔ם עָרִ֖ים שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃

controles.web: All these were the cities of the children of Merari according to their families, even the rest of the families of the Levites. Their lot was twelve cities.
controles.kjv: So all the cities for the children of Merari by their families, which were remaining of the families of the Levites, were by their lot twelve cities.
controles.livre: Todas as vilas dos filhos de Merari por suas famílias, que restavam das famílias dos levitas, foram por suas porções doze vilas.

versos.hebraico: כֹּ֚ל עָרֵ֣י הַלְוִיִּ֔ם בְּת֖וֹךְ אֲחֻזַּ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עָרִ֛ים אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנֶ֖ה וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽן׃

controles.web: All the cities of the Levites in the midst of the possession of the children of Israel were forty-eight cities with their suburbs.
controles.kjv: All the cities of the Levites within the possession of the children of Israel were forty and eight cities with their suburbs.
controles.livre: E todas as vilas dos levitas em meio da possessão dos filhos de Israel, foram quarenta e oito vilas com seus campos.

versos.hebraico: תִּֽהְיֶ֨ינָה֙ הֶעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה עִ֣יר עִ֔יר וּמִגְרָשֶׁ֖יהָ סְבִיבֹתֶ֑יהָ כֵּ֖ן לְכָל־הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃ס

controles.web: Each of these cities included their suburbs around them. It was this way with all these cities.
controles.kjv: These cities were every one with their suburbs round about them: thus were all these cities.
controles.livre: E estas cidades estavam separadas a uma da outra cada qual com seus campos ao redor delas: o qual foi em todas estas cidades.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן יְהוָה֙ לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־כָּל־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לָתֵ֣ת לַאֲבוֹתָ֑ם וַיִּרָשׁ֖וּהָ וַיֵּ֥שְׁבוּ בָֽהּ׃

controles.web: So Yahweh gave to Israel all the land which he swore to give to their fathers. They possessed it, and lived in it.
controles.kjv: And the Lord gave unto Israel all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt therein.
controles.livre: Assim deu o SENHOR a Israel toda a terra que havia jurado dar a seus pais; e possuíram-na, e habitaram nela.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֨נַח יְהוָ֤ה לָהֶם֙ מִסָּבִ֔יב כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לַאֲבוֹתָ֑ם וְלֹא־עָ֨מַד אִ֤ישׁ בִּפְנֵיהֶם֙ מִכָּל־אֹ֣יְבֵיהֶ֔ם אֵ֚ת כָּל־אֹ֣יְבֵיהֶ֔ם נָתַ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה בְּיָדָֽם׃

controles.web: Yahweh gave them rest all around, according to all that he swore to their fathers. Not a man of all their enemies stood before them. Yahweh delivered all their enemies into their hand.
controles.kjv: And the Lord gave them rest round about, according to all that he sware unto their fathers: and there stood not a man of all their enemies before them; the Lord delivered all their enemies into their hand.
controles.livre: E o SENHOR lhes deu repouso ao redor, conforme todo o que havia jurado a seus pais: e nenhum de todos os inimigos lhes parou diante, mas sim que o SENHOR entregou em suas mãos a todos os seus inimigos.

versos.hebraico: לֹֽא־נָפַ֣ל דָּבָ֔ר מִכֹּל֙ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַטּ֔וֹב אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הַכֹּ֖ל בָּֽא׃פ

controles.web: Nothing failed of any good thing which Yahweh had spoken to the house of Israel. All came to pass.
controles.kjv: There failed not ought of any good thing which the Lord had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.
controles.livre: Não faltou palavra de todas as boas coisas que o SENHOR falou à casa de Israel; tudo se cumpriu.
